title: About the platform
tagline: 从需求到交付的一站式 AI 交付平台
flow: Automated software delivery workflow: clarification, start, development, verification, review, deployment, testing, delivery, operations — iterating continuously
metroSub: Delivery Line 9 · one run per workitem, stops all the way
metroLoop: Delivered · auto-return for the next run
clarificationDesc: You describe it; AI asks until scope, stack and acceptance criteria are nailed down, then writes a plan
startDesc: You click Start; the task package lands on your own machine - code never leaves your network
developmentDesc: AI codes against the plan: one branch per requirement, every change recorded
verificationDesc: Not done until tests pass: unit tests, self-check scripts and acceptance items verified automatically
reviewDesc: Reviewer signs off before release: artifacts and gates checked item by item, or it goes back
deploymentDesc: Runnable artifacts shipped: code plus start/stop scripts, ready to run as-is
testingDesc: Regression before release: the whole chain verified against the real environment
deliveryDesc: You accept; conclusions write back: 8 artifacts archived, status synced to ZenTao/TAPD
opsDesc: Watched after launch: full run history; new bugs feed the next iteration
